kebab_example: aliyun agentloop update-pipeline --agent-space my-agent-space --pipeline-name my-pipeline --description '我的流水线' --source '{"inputFields":[{"name":"question","type":"text"}],"type":"dataset","logstore":{"query":"0_SELECT_0","project":"my-sls-project","logstore":"my-sls-logstore"},"dataset":{"filter":"status_=_pending","dataset":"my-dataset"}}' --pipeline '{"nodes":[{"id":"node-1","type":"transform","parameters":{"key":"example-string"}}]}' --sink '{"condition":{"defaultSink":{"type":"dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"other-result"}},"routes":[{"expression":"0_where_intent_=_refund","sink":{"type":"dataset","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"refund-result"}},"id":"refund"}],"matchMode":"all"},"type":"condition","dataset":{"agentSpace":"my-agent-space","dataset":"my-dataset"}}' --execute-policy '{"mode":"Scheduled","scheduled":{"fromTime":1735660800000,"interval":"1h"},"runOnce":{"fromTime":1735660800000,"toTime":1735747200000}}' --client-token a1b2c3d4-1234-5678-90ab-cdef12345678 --region cn-hangzhou
